digest.component_or_area: Error reporting across CLI, library, and MCP interfaces
propositions: MCP tool failures currently arrive as unstructured prose or ad-hoc partial shapes instead of the structured error_envelope that the CLI already emits

A single shared error code classifier (error_code_for) and vocabulary (KNOWN_ERROR_CODES) must be created in the library layer so all three interfaces (library, CLI, MCP) emit identical codes for the same failure

MCP failures must be wrapped in McpEnvelopeError to carry a structured .envelope dict containing error, message, input, and exit_code, delivered via ToolError.__cause__ and recovered by test harnesses and wire clients

The error code must be classified by exception type (isinstance checks for TicketNotFoundError, ConcurrencyError, ConcurrencyMismatch, TrackerRootError, LLMError) rather than message substring matching to ensure stability across message rewording

MCP's two existing soft-error returns (explain_criterion and llm failures) must be migrated to use vocabulary codes from KNOWN_ERROR_CODES while preserving their existing agent-branching signal fields (kind, resolution_class, retryable, diagnostic)

CLI output must remain byte-identical: the message-keyed deps_failed vs ticket_not_found distinction at reads_cli.py:410 is preserved, and all 12 existing CLI emitter sites continue emitting the same codes
